title: Bermuda Triangle compass deviations from ancient meteorites

tellings.quote: my personal belief is that there were probably in ancient ancient ancient times metal uh meteorites that landed under the ocean floor

plain: Compasses go wrong in the Bermuda Triangle, a stretch of ocean off Florida known for stories of ships and planes going missing, because metal meteorites landed under the sea floor in very ancient times. That is the personal belief of Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, who offers it as his own explanation rather than something he saw.
